Remark
[constant-mean-curvature hypersphere rigidity]

Source: petersen:page-0375, petersen:page-0376 ↗ def:pet-ch9-codazzi-exterior-derivative ↗ rem:pet-ch9-exercise-9-6-11 1. ch9:9.6.12For an isometric immersion $(M^n,g)\hookrightarrow \mathbb R^{n+1}$:

  1. prove that the second fundamental form $\mathrm{II}$ is Codazzi;

  2. prove Liebmann’s theorem: constant mean curvature and $\mathrm{II}\ge 0$ imply that $(M,g)$ is a constant-curvature sphere. The nonnegativity assumption cannot simply be omitted, since Wente’s immersed tori have constant mean curvature.
